response.title: FY2027 Budget Request to Open a Sixth Site at Eastgate
response.dek: Staff ask the board to approve a $1,610,000 FY2027 budget that adds a sixth site and two site coordinators to keep up with growing demand.

stat.label: FY2027 budget staff ask the board to approve

sections.heading: What the money pays for
sections.body: The FY2027 budget opens a sixth site at the Eastgate branch library. It also pays for two more site coordinators. Staff expect the new site to serve 180 more learners a year and cut the waitlist in half.

sections.heading: Why more adults need help
sections.body: Harborlight enrolled 1,148 adult learners in FY2026, up from 936 the year before. By year end, 287 adults were waiting for a spot, mostly at the Eastgate and Riverside sites. They waited nine weeks on average.

sections.heading: Results from FY2026
sections.body: Sixty-eight percent of learners who stayed 12 weeks or more moved up at least one reading level. Seventy-one learners earned a high school equivalency credential, a Harborlight record. Our 214 volunteer tutors gave 9,870 hours of tutoring.

sections.heading: Where the money stands
sections.body: Harborlight spent $1,420,000 to operate in FY2026, and 81 percent of that went to programs. Foundation grants brought in $640,000, individual donors $388,000, and the city contract $295,000. Reserves cover 3.2 months of operating costs, short of the board's 4-month goal.

points.text: Each learner cost $1,237 to serve in FY2026.
Harborlight has 11 full-time staff, four of them site coordinators.
Reserves sit at 3.2 months, below the 4-month goal.
Board members asked for a short funder deck about the sixth site.

quote.text: I read my granddaughter a bedtime story for the first time this spring.
quote.who: A learner at the Riverside site

response.next: The board will vote on the FY2027 budget at its October 21 meeting.
